claim: CH-2 dated 1 December 2023 incorporates the Chapter I change from ALNAV 095/23 (30 Nov 2023), revised pages 1-1 through 1-172 and A-1-a through A-1-q. Signed by D. E. Crandall.
quote: This change is issued to incorporate the change to Chapter I published by reference (a).

claim: Chapter II is Claims (FTCA, Military Claims Act, Foreign Claims Act, Article 139 claims, Personnel Claims Act).
fix: Chapter II is Administrative Investigations. Claims sit in Chapter IV (Article 139) and Chapter VIII (General Claims Provisions). Other portal pages already cite Chapter II for command investigations, so this map contradicts them.

claim: Chapter III covers investigations of incidents involving accidents, deaths and high-visibility events.
fix: Chapter III is Complaints of Wrong (Article 138). Investigations of incidents sit in Chapter II.

claim: Chapter IV covers Article 138 complaints of wrongs.
quote: IV ARTICLE 139 CLAIMS - REDRESS OF DAMAGE TO PROPERTY ... 4-1
fix: Chapter IV is Article 139 claims. Article 138 complaints are Chapter III.

claim: Chapter V covers standards of conduct, ethics and administrative procedures inside the JAG community. Later chapters cover environmental, intelligence and operational law.
quote: V RESERVED ... VI DELIVERY OF SERVICE MEMBERS, CIVILIANS, AND DEPENDENTS ... VII LEGAL ASSISTANCE ... X INTERNATIONAL LAW
fix: Chapter V is reserved. Chapters VI to XI cover delivery of members and process, legal assistance, general claims, notarial acts, international law and admiralty. Replace the chapter map with the cached table of contents.

claim: Chapter I covers military justice, investigations and court-martial procedure.
quote: I REGULATIONS IMPLEMENTING AND SUPPLEMENTING THE MANUAL FOR COURTS-MARTIAL ... 1-1
fix: Chapter I implements and supplements the Manual for Courts-Martial. Investigations are Chapter II.

claim: Effective 2021-01-14. CH-1 was the initial change after the G revision.
